label: sparse late-original-phase feature (o/w/b/l/y after p/g/3/2 context), unexplained
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.013% of steps). Never fires at t<=3 or at recall_idx>=3. About 79% of activation mass is in the late original phase (orig_idx 6-8, rate rises steeply with position, mostly in L=8-9 sequences, often on the last original token). The rest falls on <DEL> and the first one or two copy steps. Enriched input tokens are o, w, b, l, y; enriched earlier context is p, g, 3, 2, and the feature is more common when the sequence has many digits and starts with b. No predicate found gets precision above about 0.1: each enrichment is weak (lift 3-9x on a tiny base rate), and the combined predicate (late input in {o,w,b,l,y} with 3 or more p/g/3/2 seen earlier) reaches dev F1 0.08 with recall 0.29. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.24), and I found nothing that clearly modulates it. Most steps that match these surface conditions are inactive, so the feature likely encodes a hidden-state conjunction that these variables do not capture.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_tok=o (+3.40), in_tok=w (+3.36), orig0=b (+3.24), orig4=3 (+3.11), orig3=3 (+3.08), orig3=p (+3.03). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.23), prev3_tok=- (-4.06), t=3 (-3.13), phase=2 (-2.95).
